sources.snippet: Kataguru-Sceptic-35B-A3B-v2.6-GGUF is the llama.cpp / LM Studio / Ollama GGUF release of Kataguru-Sceptic-35B-A3B-v2.6, a bilingual (English & Finnish) 35-billion parameter (3B active parameters per token, 254 routed experts per layer) multimodal Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model.
